source.section: Standard Deduction Worksheet and Exemption Worksheet lines 1-8, 2025 Tax Rate Schedule and Worksheets PDF p.1 (marked DRAFT 10/01/2025); Instructions PDF p.10, Schedule M line 1v; Guide PDF p.15; Instructions PDF p.4, RI-1040 lines 1-5; PDF p.5, lines 6-8; PDF p.13, Tax Computation Worksheet ('Use for all filing status types')

worked: Federal AGI = wages 250,000.00 + military pension (person 0) 20,000.00 = 270,000.00. Federal taxable income = 270,000.00 - 15,750.00 standard deduction = 254,250.00 (given, not tested; federal senior deduction ignored). RI-1040 line 1 federal AGI 270,000.00. Line 1v military service pension 20,000.00 (in full, no age or income test). Line 1y total decreasing modifications = 20,000.00. Line 2a other-state obligations 0.00; line 2m total increasing modifications = 0.00. Schedule M page 2 line 3 net = 0.00 - 20,000.00 = -20,000.00; RI-1040 line 2 = -20,000.00. Line 3 modified federal AGI = 270,000.00 + (-20,000.00) = 250,000.00. Standard Deduction and Exemption Worksheets: line 3 250,000.00 is not more than 254,250.00: the worksheets stop at line 3, full amounts. Line 4 standard deduction: 10,900.00 (Single). Line 5 = 250,000.00 - 10,900.00 = 239,100.00. Line 6 exemptions: 1 x 5,100.00 = 5,100.00. Line 7 taxable income = 239,100.00 - 5,100.00 = 234,000.00. Line 8 tax on 234,000.00 by the schedule as numbers: 79,900.00 x 0.0375 = 2996.2500 + 101,750.00 x 0.0475 = 4833.1250 + 52,350.00 x 0.0599 = 3135.765000 = 10,965.14. Credits 0.00 (Schedule I, Schedule II, RI earned income credit and RI-1040H are not modelled and not claimed here). Rhode Island income tax = 10,965.14. Note: The worksheets read RI-1040 line 3, after modifications. Federal AGI is over 254,250 but line 3 is not, so the deductions stay whole.
